dialogue.text: At the yellow highlight inside the kitchen, face John's body. Press A to Observe. Look only; don't touch surfaces or step on evidence.
There's an empty liquor bottle here. It may relate to the reported drinking, but that needs examination. Observe it without handling it and leave it in place for SOCO.
The cordon is intact; John's body appears undisturbed. Limit contact and movement to avoid moving or transferring traces. Gloves don't prevent all contamination. Leave everything in place for SOCO.
